newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank wins state agency bonds bid.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank wins state agency bonds bid.

text.p: Thailand's largest bank, Bangkok Bank Plc, said on Friday it won a bid to underwrite a total of 3.93 billion baht ($157 million) in bond issues made by two state enterprises.
The bank early this month won a separate auction to underwrite bond issues by three state agencies totalling 7.5 billion baht.
In a statement, Bangkok Bank said it offered the lowest interest rate of 9.20 percent for the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand's 10-year bonds worth three billion baht.
It offered an 8.68 percent interest rate for the Expressway and Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand's five-year bonds worth 938.5 million baht, the bank said.
In the same auction, Thai Farmers Bank Plc won the right to underwrite the seven-year bonds worth two billion baht issued by the Government Housing Bank, an official at finance ministry told Reuters.
Thai Farmers offered an interest rate of 8.825 percent for the bonds.
Thai Military Bank Plc was awarded the bid to underwrite the Metropolitan Rapid Transit Authority's five-year bonds worth 900 million baht by offering an interest rate of 8.66 percent.
